The parser reads *bold*, /italic/, _underlined_, =verbatim=, ~code~ and
+struck+ text. Links look like [[https://orgmode.org][the Org site]] or
plain https://example.com, and a line ends here\\
on purpose.

** NEXT Check the edge cases [1/3]
- [X] Unterminated blocks
- [ ] Deep nesting
  1. lists inside lists
  2. [@7] with a counter
- [-] Wide characters: 漢字 and emoji

** Glossary
- Headline :: a line of stars and a title
- Drawer :: metadata between =:NAME:= and =:END:=
